title: Crispy Chili Chicken Tacos
description: Spicy and crispy chicken tacos with a Mexican twist. Serve with your favorite toppings and enjoy!
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, mix together the chili powder and chicken breast.
3. Add the olive oil and mix well.
5. Place the chicken on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
6. While the chicken is cooking, heat the crispy taco shells in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
7. Once the chicken is done, shred it with a fork and set aside.
8. Assemble the tacos by placing a few pieces of shredded chicken in each shell.
9. Top with shredded cheese, sour cream, diced tomatoes, and shredded lettuce.
